DOJO

Seishinkai Karate Federation Atsubetsu Branch

Atsubetsu Karate Classes

The Atsubetsu Karate Class began training at the Atsubetsu West Community Centre in April 1993.
Since its establishment, the dojo has welcomed everyone from young children to adults, offering karate classes for children, juniors, and families.
Families are especially encouraged to train together.
Branch Chief Wakabayashi and his son also joined Seishinkai as a parent-and-child team and now lead the branch together.
While many dojos focus on a highly competitive sports-club atmosphere, our goal is to provide enjoyable karate training that promotes health, fitness, and lifelong learning in a friendly club environment.
Class ① is intended for beginners.
